_comment: Explicit exceptions only. Everything else is auto-detected from each package's highest-version ebuild (inherit line / SRC_URI). Add an entry here only when auto-detection can't work or picks the wrong source. 'skip' takes a reason string; 'strategy' overrides auto-detection (pypi/github-release/github-commit/rubygems/apt-packages) with explicit parameters.
